meta.name: ast-grep
meta.description: Use ast-grep (sg) for AST-aware code search and rewrite across 25 languages. Trigger for structural code matching or deterministic codemods: find every function/call/class/import shaped like X, rewrite console.log to logger.info, strip `as any`, migrate require() to import, find empty catch blocks or missing await, and scan/apply YAML rules. Prefer this over rg/grep when the target is syntax shape rather than text; use rg for string contents, comments, filenames, or regex-style byte searches.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用语法树精准搜索和改写代码
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在多语言项目中按代码结构而非文本进行搜索和替换
copy.tagline_en: Search and rewrite code by syntax tree precisely
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to search and replace code by structure across multiple languages

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 能根据代码结构（而非文本）搜索和改写代码，支持 25 种编程语言。例如，找到所有特定形状的函数、调用、类或导入，并将它们批量替换。
howto.when: 当用户要求按代码结构（如函数形状、调用模式、类定义）进行查找或改写时触发。例如“找到所有带 Request 参数的函数”或“把 console.log 改成 logger.info”。

say.text: 找到所有带 Request 参数的函数。
say.note: Claude 会用 ast-grep 搜索匹配的函数定义。

say.text: 把项目中所有 console.log 替换成 logger.info。
say.note: Claude 会先预览再执行替换。

say.text: 扫描当前目录的 YAML 规则并显示违规。
say.note: Claude 会运行 sg scan 并报告结果。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can search and rewrite code based on AST structure (not text) across 25 languages. For example, find all functions/calls/classes/imports matching a pattern and batch-rewrite them.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks for structural code search or rewrite, such as 'find every function with a Request parameter' or 'replace console.log with logger.info'.

say_en.text: Find all functions that take a Request parameter.
say_en.note: Claude will use ast-grep to search for matching function definitions.

say_en.text: Replace all console.log with logger.info across the project.
say_en.note: Claude will preview changes before applying.

say_en.text: Scan the current directory with YAML rules and show violations.
say_en.note: Claude will run sg scan and report results.
